enchantment.marketplace.vein_miner.desc: Breaks the whole ore vein around the mined block — only blocks of the same type and only ores.
marketplace.special.vein_miner.hint: Pickaxe, shovel, axe. Incompatible with Silk Touch.
enchantment.marketplace.vein_drill.desc: Breaks a cube around the mined block — any block the tool can mine, one layer per tick.
marketplace.special.vein_drill.hint: Pickaxe, shovel, axe. Compatible with Silk Touch and Fortune. Incompatible with Vein Miner.
enchantment.marketplace.magnet.desc: Mined items go straight into your inventory instead of dropping on the ground. Uses no durability.
marketplace.special.magnet.hint: Pickaxe, shovel, axe. Compatible with every enchantment, including Vein Miner and Drill.
enchantment.marketplace.smelter.desc: Drops from mined ore are smelted immediately. Grants no experience.
marketplace.special.smelter.hint: Pickaxe, shovel, axe. Ores only. Incompatible with Silk Touch.
marketplace.special.turbo_furnace.hint: A normal furnace: fuel, recipes, hoppers, experience, redstone, recipe book. A higher level comes from combining two furnaces of the same level in an anvil.
